name: Fast Shading for Voxel Engines
definition: A fast shading algorithm for voxel engines that assumes vertical sun rays. It modifies voxel palette indices to simulate lighting, working with palettes where indices 1-32, 33-64, etc., represent dark-to-light gradients.
summary: Fast Shading for Voxel Engines is a CPU-based algorithm that simulates vertical lighting by modifying discrete palette indices based on neighbor occupancy, avoiding ray-marching for efficiency.
